This '''individual''' was a [[Troxan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served his [[Species/Legends|species]] and [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Troxar]], as the [[Under-palatine for the Bureau of Patriotic Defense|under-palatine]] for the [[Bureau of Patriotic Defense]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During that conflict, this Troxas participated in a delegation from his [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to visit [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] at [[Château Malreaux]], on the planet [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]], where he was accompanied by the [[Under-palatine for patriotic liaisons (Clone Wars)|under-palatine for patriotic liaisons]] and that individual's [[Unidentified Troxan assistant|assistant]]. In a bid to win more support for the world's resistance to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="YDR" />

The under-palatine and his compatriots tried to convince Dooku that they were planning to surrender to the Republic unless more [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] arrived in their [[Troxar system/Legends|system]]. Dooku used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to convince them to keep fighting, that reinforcements were on their way&mdash;but not to surrender. This was part of a bid by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] to make Troxar a resource sink for the Republic. At the end of their meeting, the under-palatine for patriotic liaisons presented Dooku with a parcel from [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The under-palatine of the Bureau of Patriotic Defense explained that the Troxans had analyzed the contents and found it to be only a black candle.<ref name="YDR" />
